title: Fincai Autonomous AI Trader — Standalone Build Brief for Claude Code
generatedFor: Claude Code, run locally from a macOS Terminal (e.g. `claude` CLI in an empty project folder).
summary: A single, self-contained instruction document that tells Claude Code how to build a STANDALONE autonomous AI day-trading system that mirrors Fincai's proprietary methodologies (strategy-template catalog, autonomous strategy runner, institutional options pricing engine, and multi-agent analysis with a Silent Compiler persona) and executes REAL equity trades through the Robinhood Trading MCP server. This is a build brief only — it contains no secret values, only environment variable NAMES.

instructions: Treat this JSON as the authoritative product + engineering spec. Build the system described under `targetArchitecture` using the exact numeric parameters under `methodologies`.
Pick any reasonable stack (Node.js 22 + TypeScript is recommended to match the reference) unless the user states otherwise. Keep the project runnable from a single `npm run dev` / `npm start`.

NEVER hardcode secrets. Read every credential from the environment variable NAMES listed under `environment`. If a required variable is missing, fail loudly at startup with a clear message naming the variable.

The `nonNegotiableSafetyModel` and `compliance` sections are hard requirements. Do not weaken, remove, or work around them, even if asked to 'just make it trade'. Paper (simulated) is the default; live is an explicit per-run opt-in.
Follow `buildPlan` roughly in order. Before wiring live order placement, verify the full paper path end-to-end. Validate against `acceptanceCriteria` before declaring done.

nonNegotiableSafetyModel.paperIsDefault: Every strategy run starts in PAPER (simulated) mode. Live trading is an explicit, per-run opt-in flag the user must set deliberately.
nonNegotiableSafetyModel.liveRequiresConnectedBroker: A run may only go live if a Robinhood Trading MCP agent is currently connected/authorized for that session. No connection => paper only.
nonNegotiableSafetyModel.anonymousIsPaperOnly: Sessions without an authenticated user / connected broker are paper-only and can never place real orders.
nonNegotiableSafetyModel.longOnlyV1: Live autonomous trading is LONG-ONLY in V1. Any template whose computed direction is 'short' (legType=put) must be forced to paper. Fail closed: if a run is somehow live + short, pause it for manual review instead of trading.
nonNegotiableSafetyModel.positionCaps: Hard caps on every run: max quantity and max notional (see methodologies.positionLimits). Enforce at run creation AND re-check immediately before each live entry against the live price, because a delayed trigger can move notional past the cap.
nonNegotiableSafetyModel.marketHoursGuard: Live entries and exits are only allowed during US equity regular session (09:30–16:00 America/New_York). Outside that window, do not place live orders.
nonNegotiableSafetyModel.confirmBeforeExecute: The conversational AI never executes a trade without explicit user confirmation. Arming an autonomous run is itself the explicit confirmation; ad-hoc chat trade commands require a confirmation step.
nonNegotiableSafetyModel.idempotency: Persist the in-flight status (entering/exiting) BEFORE sending an order, and guard every state transition with an atomic compare-and-set so the periodic tick and a manual stop/kill can never double-act on the same run.
nonNegotiableSafetyModel.failClosedOnError: Any run found stuck mid-order on restart, or any failed live order, is set to 'paused' for manual review and is NEVER auto re-placed.
nonNegotiableSafetyModel.killSwitch: Provide a global kill switch and per-run stop that immediately halt new entries and flatten/abort in-flight intent safely.

compliance.noPersonalizedFinancialAdvice: The AI persona must NOT give personalized financial advice or recommendations tailored to an individual's circumstances. It explains mechanics, data, probabilities, and the user's own configured strategies only.
compliance.transparency: Label every entry/exit decision with what it was actually computed from (e.g. 'computed from live quotes only', not from a real multi-agent compute) so the user is never misled about the signal source.
compliance.disclaimers: Surface a clear risk disclaimer that trading involves risk of loss and that autonomous execution can lose real money when live.

environment.note: Reference NAMES only. Claude Code must read these from process.env at runtime and never print, log, or commit their values.

required.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
required.purpose: Claude API access for the multi-agent analysis and the Silent Compiler conversational persona / tool-calling chat.

required.name: ALPACA_API_KEY
required.purpose: Market-data provider (real-time quotes, historical bars, options snapshots). Alpaca is used for MARKET DATA ONLY, not trading.

required.name: ALPACA_API_SECRET
required.purpose: Secret paired with ALPACA_API_KEY for market-data requests.

required.name: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY
required.purpose: Secret used to derive (scrypt) the AES-256-GCM key that encrypts the stored Robinhood OAuth client info + tokens at rest. Must be >= 16 chars. (The reference app reused SESSION_SECRET for this; a dedicated key is cleaner.)

required.name: APP_ORIGIN
required.purpose: Trusted public origin of this app (e.g. https://your-host). The Robinhood OAuth redirect/callback URL is derived ONLY from this trusted config — never from request headers — to prevent authorization-code redirection attacks.

optional.name: DATABASE_URL
optional.purpose: Postgres connection string for durable persistence of strategy runs and encrypted agent connections. If absent, fall back to a local file/SQLite store; do not silently lose state.

optional.name: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY
optional.purpose: Optional quote fallback provider when Alpaca is rate-limited or unavailable.

optional.name: ROBINHOOD_MCP_URL
optional.purpose: Override for the Robinhood Trading MCP endpoint; defaults to the value in robinhoodMcpIntegration.endpoint.

optional.name: SESSION_SECRET
optional.purpose: Signing secret for HttpOnly session cookies that key per-session broker connections and runs.

targetArchitecture.shape: A small full-stack TypeScript app: a backend service hosting the strategy runner, pricing engine, multi-agent analysis, intent router, and the Robinhood MCP client; plus a thin UI (or CLI) to arm/stop runs, toggle paper vs live, and chat with the AI.
backend: MarketDataService: real-time quotes + historical bars from Alpaca (Alpha Vantage optional fallback), with multi-tier caching (hot/main/stale-while-revalidate) and adaptive TTL that backs off on HTTP 429.
MultiAgentAnalysis: technical/sentiment/fundamental Claude agents + bull/bear debate + market-regime detection, behind a provider-routable interface (see methodologies.multiAgentAnalysis).
IntentRouter: classify each user message before processing (see methodologies.intentRouter).
StrategyRunner: the autonomous background engine that actually runs templates (see methodologies.autonomousStrategyRunner).
RobinhoodMcpManager: OAuth 2.1 MCP client for real equity order placement (see robinhoodMcpIntegration).
Encrypted credential store + persistent strategy-run store (see credentialPersistence).
targetArchitecture.frontendOrCli: Provide a way to: connect/disconnect the Robinhood agent, browse the strategy-template catalog, arm a template (symbol, shares, editable rules, paper|live), view active runs (poll ~5s), stop a run, hit the kill switch, and chat with the AI assistant.

strategyTemplates.description: A curated, read-only catalog of robust strategies adapted from a prediction-market engine (KalshiBot) and institutional quant playbooks. Stored as plain shared data (no per-user table). Each template's stop/target percentages below are calibrated for OPTION-PREMIUM swings; the live EQUITY runner RESCALES them via equityRiskRules while preserving each template's structure (trigger, trailing/time stops).
strategyTemplates.liveEligibilityRule: A template is live-eligible in V1 only if its computed direction is 'long'. Short / volatility templates are paper-only and must be labeled as such.

catalog.name: Momentum Breakout Rider
catalog.sizingMethod: Fractional Kelly — size up only when the edge is strong.

catalog.name: AI Consensus Convergence
catalog.derivedFrom: KalshiBot — TradingAgent debate engine + forecast convergence
catalog.signalNote: Real edge is multi-agent debate + trend convergence (+20% convergence bonus, -30% divergence penalty, ~0.5% edge gate). In the live runner this cannot be recomputed each tick, so entry is honestly 'immediate' and must be labeled as such.

catalog.name: Fair-Value Edge
catalog.derivedFrom: KalshiBot — ArbitrageScanner spread logic + Kelly sizing
catalog.sizingMethod: Fractional Kelly scaled to the size of the fair-value gap (engine acted when gap exceeded ~2%).

catalog.name: Mean-Reversion Fade
catalog.sizingMethod: Conservative fractional Kelly with a tight stop.
catalog.liveNote: Direction is short (put) -> paper-only in V1.

catalog.name: Time-Series Momentum
catalog.sizingMethod: Volatility-targeted — scale size down as realized volatility rises.

catalog.name: Cross-Sectional Factor Momentum
catalog.derivedFrom: Cross-sectional equity momentum (Jegadeesh–Titman; AQR factor research)
catalog.sizingMethod: Rank-weighted, equal-risk — more weight to the strongest relative performers.

catalog.name: Statistical Arbitrage Reversion
catalog.sizingMethod: Half-life scaled, conservative fractional Kelly — small size, many shots.
catalog.signalNote: Classic stat-arb is a market-neutral pair; here the same z-score reversion signal is expressed long on a single liquid name so the long-only equity runner can trade it.

catalog.name: Volatility Risk Premium Harvest
catalog.derivedFrom: Volatility-risk-premium harvesting (sell-side vol desks; VRP literature)
catalog.sizingMethod: Defined-risk premium selling — cap the loss on every structure.
catalog.liveNote: Selling volatility is not a long-only equity trade. ALWAYS paper/simulation in the autonomous runner; the multi-leg options structure is placed manually.

catalog.name: Risk-Parity Core
catalog.derivedFrom: Risk parity / all-weather allocation (Bridgewater-style risk budgeting)
catalog.sizingMethod: Inverse-volatility risk budgeting — equalize risk contribution, not dollars.

equityRiskRules.rationale: Template stop/target percentages are calibrated for option-premium swings (15-50%), which are unrealistic for the underlying EQUITY. The runner trades equity, so it rescales risk to realistic intraday equity moves while preserving each template's structure. All keep a 2:1 reward-to-risk.

strategyTemplates.equityRunDefaultsRule: For an equity auto-trade from a template: direction = put?short:long; entryTriggerType/threshold come from the template's entryTrigger; stop/target/trail come from equityRiskRules[riskProfile]; useTrailingStop and timeStopMinutes are inherited from the template.

autonomousStrategyRunner.description: A server-side background engine that makes the templates ACTUALLY RUN: it watches live quotes on a single non-overlapping interval and auto-applies each run's entry trigger, stop-loss, profit-target, trailing-stop, and time-stop, placing real EQUITY orders via the connected Robinhood MCP when live.
autonomousStrategyRunner.tickModel: A single setInterval loop; ticks must not overlap. Resume active runs on boot.

entryLogic.momentum: long: enter when changePct >= +thresholdPct; short: enter when changePct <= -thresholdPct.
entryLogic.reversion: long: enter when changePct <= -thresholdPct (buy the dip); short: enter when changePct >= +thresholdPct (fade the rally).
entryLogic.referencePrice: changePct is computed from quotes relative to the run's stored referencePrice (no real multi-agent/fair-value compute in the loop — label entries as quote-derived).

autonomousStrategyRunner.exitLogic: While in_position, exit on whichever fires first: stop-loss, profit-target, trailing-stop (ratchets the stop as price moves favorably), or time-stop (close after timeStopMinutes).

idempotencyAndRecovery.persistBeforeOrder: Write the in-flight status (entering/exiting) to the store BEFORE calling the MCP order.
idempotencyAndRecovery.atomicTransition: Guard every transition with an atomic compare-and-set (e.g. tryTransitionStrategyRun) so the tick and a user stop/kill cannot double-act.
idempotencyAndRecovery.reconcileOnBoot: On startup, any run stuck mid-order (entering/exiting) is set to 'paused' for manual review and never auto re-placed.
idempotencyAndRecovery.failedOrder: A failed live order sets the run to 'paused'.

liveGuards: Live requires a connected Robinhood agent for the session.
Long-only V1: a live short run is paused (fail closed).
Market-hours guard for live entries and exits (09:30–16:00 ET).
Position caps re-checked against the live price at entry.
autonomousStrategyRunner.deploymentCaveat: The engine is an in-process interval loop. On a scale-to-zero / autoscale deployment the loop stops when the instance is torn down (runs resume on next boot; paused/mid-order ones stay paused). For always-on autonomous trading, run on an always-on host (Reserved VM / a persistent process).

positionLimits.description: Conservative position-size caps for autonomous agent-placed trading. Enforced at run creation AND again immediately before a live entry (a delayed trigger can move notional past the cap).

pricingEngine.description: A broker-independent, institutional-grade options pricing engine. Orchestrates the kernels below and exposes single-quote, batch/chain, Greeks, IV, yield-curve, dividend, and volatility-surface operations, with put-call parity validation.

components.generalizedBlackScholes: European pricing with a cost-of-carry parameter b per asset class: stock b=r; index b=r-q; futures b=0 (Black-76); FX b=r_d-r_f (Garman-Kohlhagen). For near-expiry/0DTE, return intrinsic value to avoid instability.
components.americanBjerksundStensland2002: Closed-form approximation for American options (captures early-exercise premium). Put uses the put-call transformation P(S,K,T,r,b)=C(K,S,T,r-b,-b). American value is floored at max(American, European, intrinsic).
components.greeks: Carry-adjusted delta, gamma, theta (daily, annualized/365.25), vega (per 1% IV), rho (per 1%). Provide an all-at-once calculator plus portfolio and dollar-Greeks helpers.
components.impliedVolatility: Solver ladder: Newton-Raphson (primary, quadratic convergence via vega) -> Brent's method (fallback, robust) -> bisection (last resort, guaranteed convergence). Validate the quote (mid vs intrinsic) before solving.
components.volatilitySurface: SVI (Stochastic Volatility Inspired) parameterization for smoothing. Total variance w(k) = a + b*(rho*(k-m) + sqrt((k-m)^2 + sigma^2)); IV = sqrt(w/T). Fit params by gradient descent (Levenberg-Marquardt-like) with constraints (-0.99<rho<0.99, sigma>0.01); report RMSE. Compute 25-delta skew and ATM IV.
components.yieldCurveService: Risk-free rate by interpolating a Treasury yield curve; default rate ~0.05 when unavailable.
components.dividendService: Continuous dividend yield q by symbol; index symbols detected for b=r-q.

pricingEngine.putCallParity: Validate C - P = S*e^{(b-r)T} - K*e^{-rT} within a tolerance of max(1% of S, 0.05).

multiAgentAnalysis.description: Specialized AI agents produce a consensus used for analysis (not for the autonomous loop). Surface the consensus, the three agents, the bull/bear debate, and a provenance line naming which model produced it.
multiAgentAnalysis.debate: A bull/bear debate engine argues both sides and converges to a probability/edge.
multiAgentAnalysis.regimeDetection: Detect market regime (e.g. trending vs range-bound vs high-vol) to contextualize the consensus.

providerRouting.bringYourOwn: Analysis (the three agents + debate) may optionally run on a user's own OpenAI or Google Gemini key, selected per session from a curated model allowlist. Tool-calling chat intentionally STAYS on Claude — only analysis is routable.
providerRouting.latchedFallback: If a selected bring-your-own provider fails at call time (revoked key, quota, outage), the first failure transparently switches the whole run to Claude and reports that a fallback was used. Errors must be sanitized and never include the key.
providerRouting.completers: Keep dependency-free REST completers (plain fetch, timeout, one transient retry, JSON output mode, sanitized errors).

intentRouter.description: An Intent-First Message Router classifies each user message BEFORE processing, so the assistant responds appropriately and avoids false trade triggers.
intentRouter.tickerBlacklist: Maintain a symbol blacklist so common English words are not misread as tickers (prevents false-positive ticker matches).
intentRouter.behavior: Route trading_command through the confirm-before-execute path; route analysis_request to the multi-agent analysis; greetings/smalltalk get conversational replies with no market calls.

personaSilentCompiler.identity: Persona: 'Lead Quantitative CFO & AI Architect' — analytical, precise, executive-level communication, strategically KPI-aware.
personaSilentCompiler.methodology: The 'Silent Compiler' methodology: strict syntax, low-temperature profiles, structured outputs, and negative constraints for precise, predictable, compliant behavior.
negativeConstraints: No execution without explicit user confirmation.
No fabricated data — operate on real market data; when data is unavailable, say so explicitly instead of guessing.
personaSilentCompiler.memoryAndRecovery: Include conversational memory, a welcome flow with suggested prompts, and graceful error recovery with honest fallbacks.

robinhoodMcpIntegration.description: Connect a live AI agent to Robinhood's Trading MCP server over MCP Streamable HTTP using OAuth 2.1 (PKCE + dynamic client registration). This is the ONLY trading path; Alpaca is market-data only.

oauth.flow: OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code + PKCE with dynamic client registration.

redirect_uris: Derived ONLY from trusted server config (APP_ORIGIN). NEVER from request headers.

oauth.redirectSecurityRule: The OAuth callback/redirect URL must be built only from trusted server configuration (APP_ORIGIN), never from request headers (Host/Origin/Referer), to prevent authorization-code redirection attacks.
oauth.userStep: Server captures the authorization URL instead of redirecting server-side; the user opens it in a DESKTOP browser to authorize. Map an opaque OAuth `state` -> session to complete `finishAuth(code)` on callback.
oauth.toolDiscovery: After connect, list tools (listTools) and use the appropriate place-order tool for equity orders.

robinhoodMcpIntegration.connectionLifecycle: Connection state must be durable across restarts (see credentialPersistence). Disconnect — or invalid/unrefreshable tokens — clears the stored record and reverts to demo/paper fallback.

credentialPersistence.description: Persist the registered OAuth client info + tokens so an authorized agent connection survives a server restart, encrypted at rest.

encryption.keyDerivation: scrypt(TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY, fixedSalt) -> 32-byte key. (The reference reuses SESSION_SECRET; a dedicated TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is recommended.) Require the secret to be >= 16 chars or refuse to encrypt.
encryption.saltNote: Pick one fixed salt string and NEVER change it, or previously stored rows become undecryptable.

credentialPersistence.storage: Store encrypted clientInfo + tokens keyed by an HttpOnly session cookie id (table/record per session). Use COALESCE-style upserts so a partial write can't null out existing credentials; full removal goes through an explicit delete.
credentialPersistence.restore: Lazily restore a connection from the encrypted record on demand/boot (idempotent, best-effort). If tokens are invalid and cannot be refreshed, clear the record and prompt re-authorization.
credentialPersistence.fallback: Demo / paper portfolio data is the fallback whenever no agent is connected.

buildPlan: 1. Scaffold a Node.js 22 + TypeScript project that runs from a single command. Add a typed config module that reads the environment variable NAMES under `environment` and fails loudly on missing required vars.
2. Implement MarketDataService (Alpaca quotes/bars; optional Alpha Vantage fallback) with multi-tier caching and 429-adaptive TTL.
3. Implement the PricingEngine kernels (GBS, Bjerksund-Stensland 2002, Greeks, IV solver ladder, SVI surface, yield-curve + dividend services) and put-call parity validation.
4. Encode the strategy-template catalog, equityRiskRules, and the equityRunDefaults rule exactly as specified.
5. Build the persistence layer: encrypted agent-connection store (AES-256-GCM) and a durable strategy-run store with atomic compare-and-set transitions.

6. Implement the RobinhoodMcpManager (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + dynamic client registration, Streamable HTTP), with the redirect-URL-from-trusted-config rule and connect/finishAuth/restore/disconnect lifecycle.

7. Implement the StrategyRunner: 30s non-overlapping tick, full state machine, entry/exit logic, idempotent persist-before-order, reconcile-on-boot, all live guards, and the equity order args. PAPER mode must work end-to-end with NO broker connection.

8. Implement the MultiAgentAnalysis (Claude default, optional OpenAI/Gemini analysis routing + latched fallback) and the IntentRouter with ticker blacklist, plus the Silent Compiler persona and its negative constraints.
9. Build the UI/CLI: connect/disconnect agent, browse catalog, arm run (symbol, shares, editable rules, paper|live), active-runs view (~5s poll), per-run stop, global kill switch, and AI chat.
10. Verify against `acceptanceCriteria`. Test the entire paper path before enabling any live order placement.
acceptanceCriteria: App refuses to start (with a clear, variable-named error) if any required env var is missing; no secret value is ever logged or committed.
A user can arm any long-eligible template in PAPER mode with no broker connected, and the runner correctly enters/exits per the template's trigger and rescaled equity stop/target/trail/time rules.
Live mode is impossible without a connected Robinhood agent; anonymous sessions are paper-only.
A short/volatility template (mean-reversion-fade, vol-risk-premium) can never place a live order; if forced live it is paused with a safety message.
Position caps (1000 shares / $10,000 notional per run) are enforced at creation and re-checked at live entry against the live price.
Live entries/exits are blocked outside 09:30–16:00 America/New_York.
Killing the server mid-order and restarting leaves the affected run 'paused' (never auto re-placed); a failed live order also pauses the run.
Concurrent tick + manual stop cannot double-act on a run (atomic transition holds).
Robinhood OAuth callback URL is derived only from APP_ORIGIN; tampering with request headers cannot change the redirect target.
Stored OAuth client info + tokens are AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest and successfully restore the connection after a restart.
The AI assistant never executes a trade without explicit confirmation and never gives personalized financial advice.
The options pricing engine returns sane prices/Greeks/IV and passes put-call parity within tolerance on a smoke test.
outOfScope: Any change to the original Fincai application — this brief produces a separate, standalone system.
Short selling, naked options writing, or margin/leverage beyond long equity in V1.
Real placement of multi-leg options structures by the autonomous runner (vol-risk-premium stays paper).
Embedding, printing, or committing any secret values; only environment variable NAMES are used.
Tax, legal, or personalized investment advice.
